properties.name: cipher.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the Cipher Spring Boot Starter autoconfiguration.

properties.name: cipher.algorithm
properties.description: Default authenticated symmetric cipher algorithm (AES_256_GCM, AES_128_GCM, CHACHA20_POLY1305).

properties.name: cipher.active-key-version
properties.description: Active key version identifier used for all new encryption operations.

properties.name: cipher.keys
properties.description: Key version to secret key material mapping (Base64 or Hex encoded).

properties.name: cipher.payload-prefix
properties.description: Prefix used when formatting ciphertext envelopes (e.g. 'enc').
